UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Public-safe user account profile and authentication method metadata (no PII stored here).

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the account owner.

displayName.description: User display name shown in the Izi AI workspace.

method.description: Authentication method used to register the account.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the account was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was last updated.

UserPrivateInfo.title: UserPrivateInfo
UserPrivateInfo.description: Isolated PII document containing user email, phone number, and normalized identifier strictly accessible only by the owner.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the account owner.

method.description: Authentication method associated with this account.

identifier.description: Normalized email address or E.164 phone number.

email.description: Optional email address of the user.

phone.description: Optional E.164 phone number with country code.

photoURL.description: Optional profile avatar URL from Google Sign-In.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when private info was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when private info was last updated.

/users/{userId}.description: Registered Izi AI user profile document verifying the user has created an account in the database.

/users/{userId}/private/{docId}.description: Isolated PII subcollection (document ID 'info') accessible strictly by the owning authenticated user.
